visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with long dark hair, wearing a light blue face mask and a white t-shirt, holds a silver coin up to the camera lens in a close-up shot. The background is a brightly lit, slightly blurry indoor space resembling a restaurant with white tables. (2) The girl places the coin into a pink and burgundy mechanical fortune-telling roulette machine sitting on a white table. Her hands are visible as she operates the device. (3) The machine's internal wheel spins rapidly under a clear plastic dome. The girl and her friends, one wearing a green striped shirt and glasses, watch as a long, narrow pink paper slip begins to emerge from a slot at the base. (4) The camera pans to follow the extremely long pink paper as it is pulled out. The girl holds the paper with both hands, revealing printed text and star symbols organized in columns. (5) The girl and her friend read different sections of the paper, including a 'luck index' and 'romance' section. Close-up shots show the details of the pink paper with Chinese characters. (6) Visual overlays of cartoon characters (a woman with a microphone and a male reporter) appear over the paper during a joke segment. (7) The group laughs together at the table, where two bowls of tofu pudding (douhua) and plastic cups of tea are visible. The editing features fast cuts and zoom-ins for emphasis.

A metallic click is heard as a coin is inserted. (2) Whirring mechanical sound of a spinning roulette wheel. The voice expresses excitement. A playful 'pop' SFX accompanies the appearance of a paper slip. (3) Sound of continuous laughter from multiple females. Paper rustling sounds are prominent as the long strip is unrolled. (4) The speaker reads the text on the paper with a melodic, storytelling tone. Sharp 'impact' SFX are used for comedic emphasis during the luck reading. (5) A series of short jokes are read with exaggerated vocal inflections, mimicking a narrator and a reporter. The background music maintains a consistent, happy vibe. (6) High-energy collective laughter concludes the audio track, with the speaker making a final recommendation in a friendly, conversational tone.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain viewers by sharing a fun and low-cost experience of using a vintage-style fortune-telling machine found in a restaurant. It uses humor, particularly through the 'friction with friends' prediction and the 'bad jokes' included on the long paper slip, to engage the audience.
